title: Host utilization briefly reports DL560 and Mac as peerDisconnected with stale metrics while federation attestation stays authenticated (lastSuccessfulRpc never populated)
outcome: Host utilization briefly reports DL560 and Mac as peerDisconnected with stale metrics while federation attestation stays authenticated (lastSuccessfulRpc never populated)
acceptance: The cause of the discrepancy is established from source and diagnostics: a real transient link loss, a utilization RPC timeout or failure, or a projection or staleness artefact. It is stated as CONFIRMED with evidence, not assumed.

Whatever the cause, the status surface reports a peer's state truthfully and consistently with attestation and link state, and an unavailable or stale state names its reason (for example 'utilization RPC timed out at T, last fresh at T0'). A behavioural test covers the transition.
lastObserved.lastSuccessfulRpc and lastSuccessfulWake are either populated on successful RPCs and wakes, or removed if unused.
The independent review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding, and the full gate passes on the exact committed tree that lands.
